author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 7: Grid-Based Greedy + SLSQP Hybrid
abstract:
This experiment improves upon the promising Greedy+SLSQP hybrid (ID 934). The previous version used random sampling to find circle placements, which is suboptimal.
This version replaces random sampling with a deterministic grid search (100x100 grid).
By systematically evaluating points on a grid, the greedy heuristic can more accurately find the largest available space for each new circle, producing a higher quality seed for the SLSQP refinement stage.
